limitations: Lifetime blocking reservation only; no registration, release or persistence transaction.
Reducers are trusted not to mutate closed-over previous state or direct external store references.
Raw main/database writers and arbitrary store.replaceReducer remain separate gates.
Protected descriptor-only spine bounded to 4096 profiles and 16384 aggregate own keys across every copied container; Reflect.ownKeys initially allocates a container key list.

One observed reducer factory and continuous root-state chain only; multiple factories, repeated initialization or root-chain discontinuity refuse reservation. Actual host-window/store binding remains a future coordinator gate.
